summary: The power of Codex with local, self-hosted models and voice Discussion | Link
content: OpenCode Superapp brings the agentic power of Codex to the models and infrastructure you choose. Run cloud, local, or self-hosted models in a native workspace where agents understand your projects, work with files, Git, and terminals, speak with you through voice, and operate Mac apps through supervised Computer Use. Private by design and extensible through skills and MCPs, it gives you capable agents without giving up model choice or control. Built from the ground up with Codex and GPT-5.6.
